name: Space launch kit · silo, pad, starter pack and platform parts

bill.spareRule: 10% rounded up on fast-inserter and space-platform-foundation, zero on everything else

supplyRule.text: perMinute = roundUp(headroom x perKit / designMinutes), headroom 1.05 for belts and 1.25 for fluids, at least 0.5; designMinutes is the longest machine chain of this bill; whole numbers at 10 and above, one decimal below.

protocol.perKitRule: measuredPerKit (accepted from start to kit completion) <= perKitTolerance x perKit. Where (perKitTolerance - 1) x perKit is smaller than the entrance's own static storage (staticStorage on the port: for a belt its dead-end entrance belt, 8 items per tile, plus its ring limit; for a fluid every pipe of that fluid plus one input fluid box of each machine using it) the rule is applied to consumedPerKit (accepted minus what still sits on belts, the ring, machine inputs, arm hands, pipes and fluid boxes at kit completion). With the current layout this applies to stone-brick, lubricant and sulfuric-acid.

supplierLinks.note: One green-circuits copy (360/min) covers the kit and rocket supplies together; split its exit belt between them.

setupNotes: Factorio 2.1.24 Space Age. Builds one launch kit and stops: rocket silo, cargo landing pad, space platform starter pack and the white-platform and white-pack-receiver items, each in its own passive provider chest on the east side, capped by one constant combinator (one negative number per item). 29 machines (assembling machine 2, one chemical plant for batteries), no modules. WEST inputs, one labelled entrance each: concrete (from the concrete supplier), plastic, iron, stone brick, sulfuric acid, lubricant, copper, steel, electronic circuits (from the green-circuit supplier). Take items out of a chest and exactly those are made again. Preserve the red ring wires, the green cap wires, the five latch deciders and their red wires, the two silo reserve deciders, the foundation-first decider, the foundation gate decider, the AM1 combinator and iron arm wires, and all arm filters and conditions. Supply electricity at the marked substation.

Feed each west entrance with its labelled material only. Concrete comes from one concrete-supplier and electronic circuits from one green-circuits copy (placed directly west, exit on the entrance row).

Caps live in one constant combinator at the east edge (one negative number per item). Each chest arm runs only while its item is below its cap; the five expensive finals (silo, pad, starter pack, collector, crusher) load exactly one craft at a time behind a latch decider, so they never take a second craft's ingredients.
Take items out of a chest and exactly those are made again; nothing else crafts.
